This blueprint records no architecture decisions, so this appendix indexes none. The decision
directory is absent from the repository and the index is empty: nothing here is a decision that was taken, and no decision has been reconstructed to fill the gap.

A blueprint that does record decisions keeps one record per decision in that directory, and this
appendix renders one row per record with the columns the record itself declares — an identifier, the
decision's title as its heading, its status, its date and the people who decided. That is the shape a
scaffolded project's decision table takes. The repository documents no convention for those records
beyond this index, so the columns above are the contract: until a record exists, the table has no rows
to show.
